Expectation still DOWNGRADED by planA (+0.0003 post-hoc ceiling for linear use); the bet is in-training nonlinear use + attention-contrast mechanism. attention_sink_probe_20260707.hypothesis: removing low-information tokens (v5/v6 compression) flattens attention over the remaining high-information tokens; filler tokens matter structurally even when their content is useless (reconciles xmeta-null with v5<v1)
attention_sink_probe_20260707.method: deployed kd_m8_refit fp16 weights, CPU fp32 eager, 64 random train rows, layer/head-averaged attention; token categories via offset mapping (script attn_sink_probe.py)

v1_mass_distribution.first_token_sink: 0.609 of all attention mass (0.544 from the final classification token's view) — dominant sink is position 0, classic Llama sink
v1_mass_distribution.budget_elapsed_loc_numerals: 0.018 mass on 5.5% of tokens — meta numerals are NOT a major sink individually

attention_sink_probe_20260707.v1_vs_v5_flatness: paired normalized attention entropy v5-v1 = +0.0243, flatter in 63/64 rows (v5 166 tok vs v1 200 tok; normalization accounts for length). CAVEAT: v1-trained model on v5 text is OOD — direction supports the flattening story but causality for the v5/v6 quality loss is not established.
design_principles_adopted: never remove tokens from a proven serializer (compression lane failures now have a mechanistic candidate, not just empirics)
additions must be short, schema-consistent, placed early (causal exposure: every later token can attend)
give load-bearing prompt signals redundant anchors rather than denoising context
current_v7 already conforms (v1 untouched + early state line); v6e's failure sat on the compressed v5 base and does not condemn the v7 cell

filler_substitution_probe_20260708.question: if low-info tokens' role is dispersion, can uniform '$' filler substitute for them (replace meta values) or restore compressed v5 (pad with $-wall)?
filler_substitution_probe_20260708.method: deployed kd_m8_refit fp16, CPU, 48 rows x 3 conditions, token-count-matched $-walls (script filler_probe.py)
findings: mechanical substitutability CONFIRMED mid-sequence: $-wall absorbs the same attention mass as natural meta junk (0.038 vs 0.033) and preserves entropy/sink almost exactly — the structural-role hypothesis holds at the mechanical level
v5+$pad recovers ~64% of the entropy gap toward v1 — partial mechanical restoration of what compression destroyed

PLACEMENT IS CRITICAL: the end-of-sequence pad hijacks 0.250 of the classification token's attention (vs 0.010-0.011 for mid-sequence regions) — junk at the tail poisons the classifier's local window; this is the same measurement that justifies v7's signal echo being the final line

deployment verdict: option A (replace meta with $) is strictly dominated — best case ties v1 while discarding weak-but-real content (turn: v6 exact-turn evidence); option B (v5+filler) restores token count so the speed motivation of compression evaporates, and is only relevant if timing ever binds again (currently 6:32/10:00). Both are science screens that cannot beat v1 — ranked below the v7 screen which bets on signal addition instead
filler_substitution_probe_20260708.correction_20260708: the 'ties-at-best' ceiling was later retracted for the ADDITION form: a constant wall has two theoretical win channels the substitution analysis missed — (1) constant-K/V registers convert row-varying filler noise into a learnable constant bias (ViT-register precedent, where dedicated junk BEAT natural junk), (2) end-position registers could act as trained aggregation buffers (the classifier reads the tail, 0.250 measured). This spawned current_v7r (v1 preserved + early register line) as a separate screen candidate; the substitution/padding forms remain dominated.

v7r_register_design_20260708.definition: current_v7r = current_v7 + constant line 'reg: ' + '$'*64 inserted after the state line (16 identical '$$$$' tokens on the HCX tokenizer)
